title: Jacques Vallee's movie project shifted to Lazar

tellings.quote: somebody was talking about making a movie with him. And then after hearing about me and talking they started talking about Well, maybe we won't. We'll do it on Bob instead. And he was super pissed off.

plain: In the 1990s, people planning a film about Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and well-known UFO researcher, dropped him and decided to make it about Bob Lazar instead, and Vallée was 'super pissed off,' says Lazar. Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, tells Michels this from his own experience. It hints at early friction between two big names in the field.
